title: Eat a half cup of broccoli sprouts most days.
subtitle: Sulforaphane source
rationale: Use the most potent dietary NRF2 inducer as a cheap, food-first antioxidant-pathway lever.

evidence.summary: Mechanism is well characterized and human trials show biomarker shifts; hard-outcome evidence does not exist yet.

indications: A food-first lever is preferred over another capsule.
avoidWhen: Immunocompromised: raw sprouts carry foodborne-illness risk.
